item.description:
# Ghostex 10.31.0
## 10.31.0 - 2026-10-22
**Ghostex 10.31.0 is out.** Pictures in floating pages open in the chat's image viewer, waiting messages can go back to the chat box, Windows repairs itself after an antivirus removes a helper program, downloads are smaller, and Read aloud arrives as an experimental feature.
### 💬 Chat
- **Click a picture in a floating page to open it in the chat's image viewer inside the page window,** with the same buttons and zoom, and arrows (or the Left and Right keys) to step through the page's pictures. - **A floating page closes on a second click outside,** so a stray click no longer loses it; Escape and its close button still close it at once. - **A floating page reopens where you left it scrolled,** and a Refresh button appears at its top right when the agent changes the page's file. - **Floating pages, table previews and diagrams open at 80% of the window's width and 95% of its height.** - **A waiting message gets a Back to composer arrow next to its play button** for Claude Code and Grok Build: it takes the message out of the agent's queue and puts it back in your chat box, unsent. - **Back to composer and the Up key now work for Grok Build's queued messages too.** - **The play button on a waiting message no longer cancels the message it was clicked for,** and does nothing once the agent has already started it. - **Arabic and other right-to-left languages read right to left in the chat box and the transcript:** such a line is right-aligned, the arrow keys follow it, and Windows no longer draws it reversed. - **Ghostex in a browser shows Arabic, Persian and Urdu text** instead of empty boxes. - **The pink question dot counts only the questions still waiting for you.**
### 📱 On the phone
- **Tap a waiting message's play icon to interrupt the agent and send it now,** or tap the arrow beside it to bring the message back to the chat box. - **Read aloud works on the phone in the chats of a computer that has it on,** with its own voice and speed, and Auto-read keeps going with the phone locked.
### 🔊 Read aloud
- **Read aloud speaks the agent's final replies on the Mac and in Ghostex in a browser,** as an experimental feature: turn on Enable Experimental Features, then switch on Read aloud in Settings > Extensions > Store. - **Auto-read in the chat's ⋯ menu reads each finished reply of the chat on screen;** choose the voice and speed in Settings > Chat.
### 🪟 Windows
- **Ghostex repairs itself when an antivirus removes one of its helper programs** instead of failing every start, and when the installed copy is gone too, it names the file and how to restore it from Protection history. - **A background service start that hangs for three minutes is replaced on the next launch.**
### 🩺 When something goes wrong
- **Ghostex waits while its background service is still starting** instead of failing with "Could not read gxserver response". - **Send Bug / Feedback can open a GitHub issue in your browser when the background service is not answering,** with your message and the startup diagnostics filled in and your personal details removed. - **`ghostex bundle` collects its diagnostics even when the background service is down.** - **A saved key or sign-in that can no longer be read says so** in Settings > Voice agent and Settings > Connectors, with a way to paste or sign in again.
### 📦 Smaller downloads
- **Linux packages are much smaller:** the x64 rpm drops from 119 to 75 MB, the deb from 92 to 76 MB, and the built-in browser component from 366 to 152 MB. - **The macOS download is about 9 MB smaller and the Windows zip about 4 MB smaller.**
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **The Linux deb installs on Debian 11 again.** - **Japanese input picks conversion candidates with Up and Down again.** - **Quick Access's project, scope and tag pickers have a proper search field.** - **A folded coordinator in the sidebar shows the highlight when one of its hidden threads is the session on screen,** on the computer and the phone. - **`ghostex settings open --tab` opens Voice agent, Connectors and Workspaces.**

# Ghostex 10.30.0
## 10.30.0 - 2026-10-22
**Ghostex 10.30.0 is out.** Claude Code workflows get their own card in the chat, permission requests say what is asked and why, the phone selects text in chats and terminals and keeps crash reports, and Claude account sessions no longer start signed out.
### 💬 Chat
- **Claude Code workflows show as a Workflow card:** its name, description and agent counts, each phase with its progress and description, one row per agent with its status, a preview and a live timer, and the script behind Show full script; click an agent to open it. - **Permission requests say what is asked and why:** the card shows what the agent wants to do, which agent is asking (background helpers included), the exact command or file, and Claude's warning when it flagged the request. - **An answered permission card no longer flashes back for a moment.** - **File edit and write approvals from Claude Code show in the chat again,** with the file and Claude's question. - **When Claude switches itself into Plan mode, Ghostex switches the session back to your mode;** a Plan mode you pick yourself stays. - **Opening a finished turn's "Worked for" card lists its tool calls in one flat list,** in the order they ran, with the agent's notes in between as plain text. - **"+N previous tool calls" sits above the last tool call,** so the earlier calls open above it in the order they ran. - **OpenCode 2 sessions get Chat View again,** and the dimmed Chat View button names the agents that support it. - **Stash prompt in More actions is one line,** with the number of stashed prompts in a small circle. - **Handover headings now default to 60% color strength;** change it in Settings > Chat > Handover heading color strength. - **The microphone always stays next to Send,** even when the chat box is narrow. - **A question card that could not be shown disappears once the agent asks again in a readable form.** - **Picking a Claude mode the session does not offer stops after one try** instead of cycling your mode.
### 📱 On the phone
- **Hold a message's words to select them,** with Copy, Add to Chat and More (the message's actions) in the menu, on Android and iPhone. - **Hold a word in the terminal to select it and drag to select more,** with Copy, Paste and Select All, on iPhone and Android. - **The phone keeps a crash report and offers to send it on the next launch,** cleaned of personal data, through Send Bug / Feedback. - **The image viewer zooms with pinch and double tap on Android** instead of crashing on a double tap. - **Saving an edited computer no longer crashes the app on Android.** - **The Docs screen is now called Files,** like the computer's Files view, and lists projects with deeply nested folders. - **The Threads sheet's rows use the sheet's normal text size.** - **The voice screen keeps your place when you scroll up,** with a button to jump back down, and Stop talking is now Stop.
### 🎧 Voice agent
- **Choose a call mode in Settings > Voice agent:** regular, or push-to-talk with a Hold to talk button, which costs less on Grok; Settings shows the price of each, on the computer and the phone. - **The voice agent knows which session is on your screen** when you say "this one", and when each message was sent.
### 🔐 Claude accounts
- **Sessions on your added Claude accounts no longer start "Not logged in"** when your default Claude login is signed out. - **A session on a turned-off or signed-out account moves to a working account when it wakes,** in the same conversation. - **Waking a Claude session no longer hangs for minutes** searching old transcripts.
### 📸 Ghostex Capture
- **Write Prompt's Send to is a dropdown that starts on the session you last used in the main window,** with the same project list and filter inside it. - **The prompt box hides during a capture** instead of leaving a strip of it on screen and in the picture. - **The capture panel, editor, prompt box and notes keep their border all the way round the corners.**
### 🪟 Windows
- **Menus and pop-ups resize in place:** clicking "N more" in the Threads menu no longer closes it and brings another app in front of Ghostex, and a closing pop-up hands focus back to Ghostex.
### 🗂️ Sidebar and coordinators
- **Collapsed project and collection headers count sessions waiting on your answers in pink,** on the computer and the phone. - **The selected Space's button no longer shows status dots,** on the computer and the phone. - **Auto Sleep keeps a coordinator awake while one of its threads is working or waiting on a question.** - **Close After Done is no longer offered for coordinators;** their threads keep it.
### ⚙️ Settings
- **Less-used settings move behind Show Advanced:** about 27 General rows and the Workspaces, Cloud Boxes, Open In and OS Integration pages, which search still finds.
### 🌐 Remote computers
- **Remote settings see a connected Tailscale** even when its command-line tool is not on your PATH, so the Tailscale phone code appears again.
### 🧰 Installed tools
- **Beads, gh and glab installed from Settings run by name in your terminals and agents right away,** and Settings shows them as installed only when a new terminal can find them.
### 📦 Smaller downloads
- **The Files view's drawing editor is about 5 MB smaller;** pasted Mermaid text now pastes as plain text instead of becoming a drawing. - **The onboarding pictures are about 1 MB smaller.**
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **Input methods in the terminal show their candidate window at the cursor as it moves** (Fcitx5 on Linux and others), thanks to @bet4it. - **Agents Hub no longer reports "Hook scripts: 1 to fix" when there is nothing to link,** and Windows paths show as ~/.claude/hooks.

# Ghostex 10.29.0
## 10.29.0 - 2026-10-20
**Ghostex 10.29.0 is out.** The voice agent comes to Windows and Linux and learns to draft, remember your last talk and show you the session it is talking about, Dictate never loses a recording, Cmd-clicked file links open at their line, and the downloads get smaller.
### 🎧 Voice agent
- **The voice agent, its panel and Dictate now work on Windows and Linux,** with the same keys and settings as on the Mac. - **It shows you the session it is talking about:** when it reads, answers or drafts in a session, Ghostex switches to it, in any project, unless you are typing; on the phone it shows an "Open <session>" chip instead. - **It can draft a message into a session's chat without sending it,** for you to read and send, and it asks out loud before sending anything risky or destructive. - **It remembers your last conversation:** a Continue / Start fresh card in the call picks up where you left off with a one-sentence recap; forget it from the panel or Settings > Voice agent. - **It answers the chat's questions for you,** by option name, number or "the recommended one", and tells you what it recorded. - **It sees an orchestrator's threads as sub-threads** and reads one when you ask for it by name. - **The voice panel can be moved,** and clicking the voice's name picks another voice; a small speed button next to it sets how fast it talks, from 1× to 2×, on the computer and the phone. - **New hotkeys:** ⌃⌥V starts or ends a voice call and ⌃⌥D dictates into the chat box (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+V and Ctrl+Alt+Shift+D on Windows and Linux). - **The headset button now sits left of Start** in the work area header.
### 🎙️ Dictate
- **Dictate never loses a recording:** it records first and transcribes after, keeps every recording, and lists them at the bottom of Settings > Voice agent to play, download, recover or transcribe to the clipboard. - **Dictating shows as a small pill right above the microphone** with the timer, Transcribing and a ✕ to cancel (Escape cancels too), and the chat box keeps its cursor so you see where the text will land.
### 💬 Chat
- **Find (Cmd+F) searches only what you can see** and highlights the matched words instead of whole blocks. - **A reply stays in view when a watcher, a background task or a timer wakes the agent again,** instead of folding into the next turn. - **Clicking anywhere on the working bar above the chat box scrolls to the bottom** while the ↓ button shows; on the phone, tap it. - **Summary mode and Stash prompt leave the chat box toolbar:** Summary mode is under More actions > View and Stash prompt is a More actions row, with the same shortcuts. - **Skip all on a question form or page now skips every question,** even ones you had already picked. - **Handover heading color strength** is a new advanced Settings > Chat slider that fades the colored Done, Needs you and Untested headings toward plain text. - **A question page shows when its questions were withdrawn,** like the chat's own forms.
### 🗂️ Sidebar and notifications
- **The New terminal button is back on every project header,** next to the agent button, on the computer and the phone. - **Every status dot is the same size,** overlapping dots get a thin ring, and Spaces and computer tabs show a dot when a session in them is waiting on your answers. - **In-progress notices pulse their dot and end with "…"** ("Committing…", "Pushing…", "Creating worktree…") until the result arrives.
### 🧭 Orchestrators
- **Show all effort levels** is a new advanced setting: the orchestrator effort pickers offer only High and XHigh unless you turn it on, since lower levels aren't recommended for orchestrators.
### 🛠 Code view
- **Cmd-clicking a `file:line` or `file:line:column` link in the terminal opens the Code view at that line,** and `ghostex edit --goto` no longer gets lost after the Code view was closed or reloaded; if no Code view takes an open within a minute, Ghostex says so instead of doing nothing (#266).
### 📦 Smaller downloads
- **The Mac download is about a third smaller** (about 76 MB instead of 110 MB). - **Windows: the installer no longer carries the Code editor and the WSL terminal engine;** Ghostex downloads them the first time you need them, so the first Code view or WSL setup needs internet.
### 📱 On the phone
- **Easy Connect reconnects after the app sat in the background,** thanks to @banozz0 (#265).
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **Windows: chat menus and pickers have one clean corner,** with and without window transparency. - **The Settings > Appearance theme previews are rounded on all four corners.**

# Ghostex 10.28.0
## 10.28.0 - 2026-10-20
**Ghostex 10.28.0 is out.** Talk to your agents out loud with the new voice agent, see at a glance which sessions are waiting on your answers, run OpenCode as an orchestrator, and hear completion sounds on Linux and Windows.
### 🎧 Voice agent - **Talk to your agents out loud:** on a Mac, the headset button in the work area header starts a spoken conversation with Ghostex's voice agent. Ask what your sessions are doing or which ones are waiting on you, have it read you a session's last messages, send a prompt, answer a question or approve a permission prompt, or start a new agent, and it tells you when a session finishes its turn. - **A panel under the header shows live captions of both sides** and the tools the agent runs, with Mute, Stop talking and Hang up; talking over it stops it, and it hangs up by itself after 5 quiet minutes. - **Bring your own key:** pick xAI Grok Voice (the default) or OpenAI GPT Realtime in Settings > Voice agent, choose a voice and paste the provider's key, which is checked before it is saved and stays encrypted on your computer. Not available on Windows or Linux yet. - **On your Android phone too:** the headset button in the top bar starts the same conversation with the computer you are looking at, and it keeps going while you switch apps or lock the phone, with a "Voice mode on" notification that has Mute and Hang up. - **Dictate is back on the Mac:** the microphone button in the chat box and on the terminal bar turns what you say into text with xAI's speech-to-text and never sends it by itself; on Android it sits in the chat box's toolbar.
### 🔔 Sessions and notifications - **Sessions waiting on your answers stand out:** when an agent ends its turn with questions you have not answered, its sidebar row shows the question dot and you get one notification, on the computer and the phone; answering clears it, and `ghostex sessions` shows "answer requested".
### 💬 Chat - **The Previous question pill and question links take you to the question itself,** even in a long reply, instead of the end of the message. On the computer and the phone. - **Answered questions show their number in the same tile as the card's icon,** lined up under the title.
### 🧭 Orchestrators - **OpenCode 2 can be an orchestrator:** pick it in New Orchestrator or run `ghostex orchestrator create --agent opencode` (#261), and the sidebar's Make Orchestrator now offers every agent an orchestrator can run on, on the computer and the phone. - **A new OpenCode chat sends its first message** instead of leaving it waiting in the queue.
### 🖥 Terminal - **Bold text uses a heavier font** is a new Settings > Terminal switch (on by default, under Show Advanced): turn it off and bold text keeps your normal font weight, so it stands out by color only. Ghostty's `bold-color`, `font-style-bold` and `font-variation-bold` in Ghostex's terminal config work too (#264).
### 🛠 Code view - **When another program holds the Code view's port,** the card names it and offers "Close it and retry" instead of "VS Code didn't start in time"; on Windows it asks for permission when it needs to. - **A Code editor another computer starts here gets its own port** and ends when that computer disconnects, so a dropped SSH connection no longer blocks your own Code view.
### 🐧 Linux and Windows - **Completion and copy sounds play on Linux and Windows:** the packages now include the sounds and the app plays them (#260). - **The Linux x64 .rpm installs with dnf again.** - **The Resources panel lists your servers on Linux.**

# Ghostex 10.27.0
## 10.27.0 - 2026-10-19
**Ghostex 10.27.0 is out.** Every one-line card in the chat gets one clean look, you can edit the orchestrator playbook for all projects or one project, Settings gathers its add-on pages into an Extensions group, and one notification bell covers every connected computer.
### 💬 Chat - **Every one-line card looks the same:** "Worked for", "Previous turn", Message from and to, background commands, model and effort changes, compactions and answered questions are all 44px cards with one font and background and a square icon on the left; their status (Delivered, Queued, Waiting, Answered) is a pill on the right, and none has a chevron. On the computer and the phone. - **Question cards show what is waiting on you:** a question waiting for your answer leads with a checklist and a yellow "?", an answered one with a question bubble and a green check, and the edited files card with a pencil. - **Question numbers sit at the right of each question** in the chat's questions form and on pages, and an unanswered question on a page shows the yellow "?" too. - **The conversation ends right above the working card,** without the extra gap that sat under the last message.
### 🧭 Orchestrators - **Edit the orchestrator playbook:** Settings > Chat > Orchestrator playbook changes the playbook every orchestrator follows, a project can have its own in Settings > Projects that also covers its worktrees, and New Orchestrator shows and edits the one it will use. - **Orchestrators you already have follow an edited playbook,** Reset to Default (click it twice) brings back Ghostex's own, a switch turns an edited copy off without losing it, and the editor tells you when Ghostex's playbook changed since you edited yours. From a terminal: `ghostex orchestrator playbook` and `ghostex orchestrator set-playbook`.
### 🧩 Settings and extensions - **An Extensions group at the bottom of Settings:** Store (the page that was called Extensions), Workspaces, Cloud Boxes, Connectors, Actions, Open In, OS Integration and Debugging sit in one collapsible group that remembers whether it is open, and a search opens it. - **Connectors, OS Integration and Debugging can be turned off in the Store** like the other built-in extensions; turning Connectors off also turns off `ghostex connectors`. - **Popups inside Settings close with the same round X as Settings itself,** shown when the pointer is near their top. - **Sections in the Settings sidebar fold with the same animation as projects in the sidebar.**
### 🌐 Remote computers - **One notification bell for every connected computer,** with All, This computer and Remote tabs: a remote notification names its computer, and clicking it switches the sidebar to that computer. - **Switching computers reopens the session you were last on there,** the way switching Spaces does.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish - **The Subagents pill no longer counts stopped or interrupted subagents as running:** subagents stopped with TaskStop or Stop all, or finished in an unusual way, leave the count, so their timers no longer grow for hours (#259). - **A codex typed in a plain zsh or fish terminal stays off Codex's shared server** even when mise or another tool reorders your PATH. - **Bordered tab switches keep their rounded corners** when the first or last tab is selected.

# Ghostex 10.26.0
## 10.26.0 - 2026-10-18
**Ghostex 10.26.0 is out.** The chat's working indicator becomes one steady card above the chat box, Copilot, Cursor, Grok and OMP work fully from the chat, model menus read each agent's own model list, orchestrators run from a skill with an agent of your choice, and a long list of fixes from your bug reports.
### 💬 Chat - **One working card above the chat box:** what the agent is doing, the running tool's name and the pills (Threads, Background, the ? question button, Delayed Send) sit in one card right above the chat box, so the conversation never jumps or scrolls under it; each pill opens its own menu, and a finished turn reads "Worked for 12s". - **The model pill shows the full model and effort:** it grows to fit the name when there's room, and hovering it names the provider, model, effort and context in full. - **Indented lines in agent replies keep their indentation** in the chat on the computer and the phone, while lists, quotes and code blocks render as before. - **Edit › Copy, Cut, Paste and Select All work in the terminal and the chat,** enabled only when they can act, so apps that read your selection through Edit › Copy get it, thanks to @banozz0. - **With several computers connected, each computer's chats show that computer's own model lists.** - **A Claude session's model chip reads only its own status line,** not another session's footer that an agent printed in the conversation.
### 🤖 Agents - **Copilot, Cursor, Grok and OMP work from the chat:** approvals and questions show as chat cards, Stop really stops, and each gets its own slash commands, mode picker, context meter and Fork where the agent supports it. Copilot's conversation shows in the chat for the first time. - **Model menus read each agent's own list:** Codex, Cursor, Grok and Antigravity menus come from the CLI's own model list, refreshed every 10 minutes, with older versions folded under Legacy models. - **Hermes 0.22 works in the chat again,** and Pi's queue no longer cuts a running turn short. - **Antigravity's Plan mode no longer lands in auto-approve,** Codex's plan mode turns off from the chat, and a model the agent refused shows what it's really running. - **Long chat messages and briefs reach OMP 18.11 again:** Ghostex now recognises the 📄 chip OMP shows for a long paste. - **ZCode:** answers to its question picker reach it from the chat, a Start Agent brief is sent instead of waiting forever, and moving a draft into the chat takes 2 seconds instead of failing after 16. - **A codex you type by hand in a Ghostex session no longer locks its conversation:** it runs without Codex's shared background server, so Ghostex's own resume never shows "This conversation is open in another app". - **Codex:** a session Codex didn't name gets a quiet name a minute after its first prompt, a session restored by its title finds its conversation, a session that never got a prompt wakes fresh, and "Enable full access?" shows in the chat. - **Grok, Antigravity and OMP sessions slept before their first prompt wake properly,** and Copilot keeps its real conversation when it resumes. - **Agent CLI updates never dead-end:** Ghostex falls back to the CLI's own updater, Copilot and Pi on Windows update, Hermes reports its update state, and OMP installs its own binary. - **Search by prompt finds Antigravity, Hermes, Copilot, Droid, OMP and ZCode prompts** and resumes their sessions.
### 🧭 Orchestrators - **Orchestrators run from the ghostex-orchestrator skill:** New Orchestrator gets an agent dropdown (Claude, Codex, ZCode, Cursor, Grok, Copilot, Antigravity, Pi and OMP), High or XHigh effort with XHigh by default, and an (i) that explains what an orchestrator is for. - **An OMP thread reports to its orchestrator once per turn,** not at every pause while it works. - **Orchestrators can answer without markers:** an advanced, not-recommended setting in Settings > Chat > Orchestrators answer without markers; Show marker emojis is an advanced setting now too.
### 🐞 Send Bug / Feedback - **Large screenshots send:** up to five screenshots of 5 MB each, the same budget as `ghostex feedback send`. - **The investigating agent starts on the computer that has the reported session,** including a remote one. - **Images can be dropped onto the dialog,** and a screenshot copied from CleanShot pastes as an image instead of its file path.
### 🔌 Connectors - **Each workspace can sign gws in with its own Google OAuth client:** Settings > Connectors > Choose client…, or `ghostex connectors gws client <client_secret.json>`. - **Connector sign-ins copy their one-time code and show it large,** with Copy and Open page again, and Settings stays open when you switch back from the browser. - **A Composio read whose tool name puts the noun first runs without an approval card.**
### 🐧 Linux and Windows - **Linux: dead keys (~, ´) no longer freeze the terminal** on Wayland and X11. - **Windows: the portable zip runs as its own Ghostex** beside an installed one, with its data, ports and lock next to itself, and it leaves the installed Ghostex's agent hooks alone. - **Windows: a Claude Swap update, reinstall or uninstall waits for running sessions** instead of breaking cswap. - **WSL: Ghostex no longer reads WSL as unavailable because of Windows PATH entries,** and WSL startup errors say what failed, thanks to @Dev-Mriganka. - **Windows: commit message generation and Generate Name work under PowerShell.**
### 🩹 Fixes and polish - **The Settings window no longer lights up the sidebar rows behind it** when you move over its menu. - **Ghostex web: the New session menu starts agents,** and the chat's More actions (Rename, Sleep, Fork, Full Reload) work. - **`ghostex board start-work` types the card's prompt into the new session,** so an agent started from the command line or an outside orchestrator gets to work instead of waiting at an empty prompt. - **One-shot jobs (commit messages, Catch me up, titles) run on the session's account or your default,** never a disabled one. - **The sidebar's bottom row sits a little higher above the window edge.**
